description: Retro run guardrails. The retro of the ADR #1575 cycle found these defects:

userStories.title: next.sh tracks an external story
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want `next.sh` to skip an external story so that an operator-owned step does not block Close.
acceptanceCriteria: The `external` rule in `.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` names the field; US-002 owns that edit.
`.agro/skills/delegate/scripts/__tests__/next.test.mjs` covers the skip, the dependency case, and a file without the field.

`.agro/skills/delegate/scripts/next.sh` treats a story with `external: true` and `passes` other than `true` as tracked. The script prints no `story <id>` line for the story, and Close, push, CI, and ready proceed.
`.agro/skills/prd/references/tracker.md` defines an optional story field `external` (boolean) for a story that another agent or the operator controls.
`.agro/skills/prd/references/tracker.md` defines an optional story field `external` (boolean). The field marks a story that another agent or the operator controls.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, merged c5f7cbd0, via agro run): next.test.mjs passes (9 new external cases: skip to close, dependency blocked message, unchanged without the field, rounds cap still applies); typecheck 0. reasoned: tracker.md schema and optional-field entry for external.

userStories.title: Probe stories and registry callers in plans
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want probe stories and registry owners in plans so that no worker blocks on a missed fact.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` § 5 holds a probe rule for a plan that adds a new execution environment or runtime path. The first story of that plan measures the real environment before any design story.

`.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` § 3 extends the caller rule to central registries, for example a verb table, a tool catalog, or a configuration field table. The advisor adds each registry file to the `files` of the story that adds an entry.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` reports no new finding on the changed lines.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, merged 292e13b8): link check 0; ste-check same 6 pre-existing findings. reasoned: probe-story rule in § 5, registry caller rule in § 3, external field sentence in the external rule.

userStories.title: Open branches take development after a release
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want each open task branch to merge `development` after a release so that the changelog does not conflict at CI time.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/git/SKILL.md` § Releases holds a merge rule. After a release merges into `development`, the advisor merges `development` into each open task branch of the advisor before the next push of that branch.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/git/SKILL.md` reports no new finding on the changed lines.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, merged 9504f4db): ste-check clean. reasoned: § Releases merge rule after a release, merge preferred over rebase.

userStories.title: agro node check
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a read-only node check so that a node create fails before the console creates a node.
acceptanceCriteria: `agro node check [--free-tier] [--ssh-key <uuid>]...` calls only `GET` endpoints of the console in the stored credentials.
Without `--ssh-key`, the check finds the public key `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` among `GET /api/ssh-keys` by key identity. With `--ssh-key`, the check finds each id in that list.
With `--free-tier`, the check reads `GET /api/free-tier` and fails unless `eligible` is `true`.
The check prints one line for each check and exits 0 only when each check passes. A failure names the remedy.
`NODE_VERBS` in `.agro/cli/src/command-table.ts` lists `check`, and the node help lists the verb.
Tests in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/` cover each check, each failure, and the absence of a `POST` call.
`agro run -- pnpm typecheck` exits 0, and `agro run -- pnpm test` shows no new failure against `evidence/baseline.md`.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, merged 6f15ae67, via agro run): node.test.ts passes (10 new cases incl. no POST/DELETE); typecheck 0; real check against the local console: fail ssh-key (unknown id), fail free-tier not eligible, exit 1; without --ssh-key: fail with the missing-key remedy. reasoned: NODE_VERBS lists check; help and docs updated.

userStories.title:
Console preflight uses the node check

- [ ] `console_preflight` in `.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/adapters/console.sh` runs `agro node check` with `--free-tier` unless `CONSOLE_FREE_TIER=0`. When `CONSOLE_SSH_KEY_ID` holds a value, the preflight adds `--ssh-key "$CONSOLE_SSH_KEY_ID"`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] `.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/SKILL.md` describes the preflight.
- [ ] `console_create` runs `console_preflight` first and creates no node when the preflight fails.
- [ ] `CONSOLE_SSH_IDENTITY` stays required, and the adapter sets no default identity path.
- [ ] `.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/SKILL.md` describes the preflight.
- [ ] `agro run -- pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox-adapters.test.ts` passes with a case for the preflight failure.

### US-006: Changelog and evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a changelog entry and a transcript so that I can confirm the node check against a live console.
acceptanceCriteria: `CHANGELOG.md` holds entries under `## [Unreleased]` that link the task issue.
`.agro/tasks/retro-run-guardrails/evidence/manual-review.md` records `agro node check --free-tier` against the local console, with its output and exit code.
